source_file: 这是苹果吗，也许是吧（4-7 岁）-.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 这是苹果吗
也许是吧
[日]吉竹伸介 著 毛丹青 译
接力出版社

[P2] 有一天，我放学回到家……
咦，
这是什么？
桌上放了一个苹果。
但是……也许……
这不是苹果。

[P3] 这也许是樱桃的一部分。
也许里面装了葡萄果冻。
也许这是一条卷成一团的红色的鱼。
也许，一直削一直削，
不管削多少层里面都是皮。
也许我没看到的那一面是橘子。

[P4] 也许里面都是零件。
颜色调节键
光滑度调节键
苹果马达
香味扩散器
苹果汁储存器
苹果天线
苹果感应器
苹果电池
也许这是某种东西的蛋。
刚刚孵出来的宝宝，
也许会以为我是它的妈妈。

[P5] 也许种到土里，它会长成一座很大的房子。
第一天
一周后
一个月后
三个月后
也许吃掉果肉，
就可以设计出自己喜欢的房间。

[P6] 也许它想尝试各种发型和帽子。
三七偏分头
大络头
麻花辫
魔术帽
消防盔
头巾
司机帽
音乐家头
艺妓头
阿姨头
棒球头盔
猫王头
相扑头
双马尾
领带头
牛仔帽
土著头
博士帽
鸡窝头
公主头
幼儿园小黄帽
士兵头盔
护士帽
丫鬟头
老干部头
也许它原本想变成其他东西。
想变成梨子，
→
但好像哪里
怪怪的。
想变成球，
→
但只有“圆圆的”
这点像。
想变成邮筒，
→
但只有“红红的”
这点像。
想变成飞机，
→
但一点儿都不像。

[P7] 也许它是从宇宙坠落的小行星。
砰——
仔细看看苹果表面，也许会发现
很多很多外星人。
苹果星人
3毫米

[P8] 也许它有灵魂。
也许伤心的时候，
它会变成白色。
也许一浇上蛋黄酱，
它就会变成软塌塌的一团。
也许到了晚上，它会
小声地打呼噜。
也许一想起过去的失败，
它就会变扁。
也许听到表扬时，
它会变得亮晶晶。
也许害怕的时候，
它会变得皱巴巴。
也许懊恼的时候，
它会变得硬邦邦。
也许它会骨碌碌打转，
然后累趴下。
也许一碰这里，
它就会疼痛。

[P9] 也许这个苹果什么都知道。
我刷牙了！
才没刷呢。
也许它喜欢我。
也许这个苹果有兄弟姐妹。
皇冠果
红苹果
馒头果
金字塔果
城门果

[P10] 也许它还有更多兄弟姐妹。
大便果 火锅果 珊瑚果 钻石果 围脖果 灯笼果 龙眼果 羊角果 皇冠果 星星果
哑铃果 方块果 鸡蛋果 奶嘴果 浴花果 眼罩果 飞行果 红苹果
面团果 软糖果 冰激凌果 甜甜圈果 酒杯果 铃铛果 菊花果 锁链果 猪头果 红咖果
花蕊果 圣诞树果 海螺果 蜘蛛果 小晶果 西瓜虫果 吸盘果 金字塔果
胡子果 宝塔果 身子果 钥匙果 章鱼果 烟花果 裙边果 香蕉果 城门果 耳机果

[P11] 不过，它为什么会来这里呢？
也许是妈妈从超市买回来的。
也许是喝醉的爸爸从什么地方拿回来的。
也许暗示着什么？
你是第五个！
看起来
心情不错啊！
也许是爷爷的爷爷的爷爷
变成苹果的样子来看我了。
也许是为了抓住我设下的陷阱吧！

[P12] 也许它在来我家之前，去过很多地方，
碰到过很多事情。

[P13] 接下来，这个苹果会怎么样呢？
它也许会叫上伙伴，大家一起回家乡。

[P14] 也许，仔细瞧一瞧，除了我，
大家都是苹果。
也许这个苹果会长出手和脚，
变得跟我一模一样。
再把我揉成一个球，
染成红色，
就这样代替我。

[P15] 啊
啊
干脆尝一口，也许味道不错。
也许没什么味道。
也许酸得不得了。
也许非常非常辣。
也许非常非常硬。
嗯——
也许黏得咬不断。
噗——噗——
也许一咬就漏气飞走了。
也许吃下去之后，
身体会变得巨大无比。

[P16] 不过……也许……这就是一个普普通通的苹果……颜色很一般，也不会动，也不会发出奇怪的声音。
不知不觉，我的肚子好像饿了……
啪嗒
戳一戳
闻一闻
摸一摸
啃一啃
妈妈，我可以吃这个苹果吗？
可以啊。

[P17] 咔嚓！
啊呜啊呜，啊呜啊呜！
咕嘟！
嗯……
也许，可以说，这是一个好吃的苹果。
full_text_en:
[P1] Is this an apple?
Maybe.
[Japan] Shinsuke Yoshizaki, author; Mao Danqing, translator
Jieli Publishing House

[P2] One day, I came home from school...
Hmm,
what is this?
There was an apple on the table.
But... maybe...
this isn't an apple.

[P3] This might be part of a cherry.
Maybe it's filled with grape jelly.
Maybe this is a red fish curled up into a ball.
Maybe, if I keep peeling and peeling,
no matter how many layers I peel, the inside is always skin.
Maybe the side I can't see is an orange.

[P4] Maybe the inside is full of parts.
Color adjustment button
Smoothness adjustment button
Apple motor
Scent diffuser
Apple juice storage
Apple antenna
Apple sensor
Apple battery
Maybe this is an egg of something.
The baby just hatched,
maybe it will think I'm its mom.

[P5] Maybe if you plant it in the soil, it will grow into a big house.
Day one
One week later
One month later
Three months later
Maybe if you eat the flesh,
 you can design your own favorite room.

[P6] Maybe it wants to try different hairstyles and hats.
Three-seventh parting
Big braid
Pigtails
Magician's hat
Firefighter's helmet
Headscarf
Driver's cap
Musician's hair
Geisha hair
Auntie's hair
Baseball helmet
Elvis hair
Sumo wrestler's hair
Ponytails
Tie hair
Cowboy hat
Native American hair
Doctor's cap
Chicken nest hair
Princess hair
Kindergarten yellow hat
Soldier's helmet
Nurse's cap
Maid's hair
Old cadre's hair
Maybe it originally wanted to become something else.
Wanted to become a pear,
→
But something feels
off.
Wanted to become a ball,
→
But only the "roundness"
is similar.
Wanted to become a mailbox,
→
But only the "redness" is similar.
Wanted to become an airplane,
→
But not even a little bit like it.

[P7] Maybe it's a small asteroid that fell from space.
Boom—
If you look closely at the apple's surface, you might discover
many, many aliens.
Apple people
3 millimeters

[P8] Perhaps it has a soul.
Perhaps when it's sad,
it turns white.
Perhaps when poured with egg yolk sauce,
it becomes a soft, saggy lump.
Perhaps at night, it
whispers softly in its sleep.
Perhaps when it remembers past failures,
it becomes flat.
Perhaps when it hears praise,
it becomes shiny and bright.
Perhaps when it's afraid,
it becomes wrinkled.
Perhaps when it's annoyed,
it becomes hard and stiff.
Perhaps it rolls around,
then collapses from exhaustion.
Perhaps when touched here,
it feels pain.

[P9] Maybe this apple knows everything.
I brushed my teeth!
No, I didn't.
Maybe it likes me.
Maybe this apple has siblings.
Crown fruit
Red apple
Steamed bun fruit
Pyramid fruit
City gate fruit

[P10] Maybe it has even more brothers and sisters.
Poop Apple Hot Pot Apple Coral Apple Diamond Apple Scarf Apple Lantern Apple Longan Apple Ram Horn Apple Crown Apple Star Apple
Dumbbell Apple Cube Apple Egg Apple Pacifier Apple Bath Flower Apple Eye Patch Apple Flying Apple Red Apple
Dough Apple Gummy Apple Ice Cream Apple Donut Apple Wine Glass Apple Bell Apple Chrysanthemum Apple Chain Apple Pig Head Apple Red Coffee Apple
Pistil Apple Christmas Tree Apple Seashell Apple Spider Apple Small Crystal Apple Watermelon Worm Apple Suction Cup Apple Pyramid Apple
Mustache Apple Pagoda Apple Body Apple Key Apple Octopus Apple Firework Apple Skirt Edge Apple Banana Apple City Gate Apple Earphone Apple

[P11] But why did it come here?
Maybe Mom bought it from the supermarket.
Maybe Dad, drunk, brought it back from somewhere.
Maybe it's hinting at something?
You're the fifth one!
Looks like
it's in a good mood!
Maybe it's my great-great-grandfather
who turned into an apple to visit me.
Maybe it's to catch the trap I set!

[P12] Maybe before it came to my house, it had been to many places,
and experienced many things.

[P13] What will happen to this apple next?
It might call its companions and go back home together.

[P14] Maybe, if you look closely, except for me,
everyone is an apple.
Maybe this apple will grow hands and feet,
and become just like me.
Then roll me into a ball,
dye it red,
and that's how it will replace me.

[P15] Ah
Ah
Maybe I should just take a bite. It might taste good.
Maybe it has no taste at all.
Maybe it's sour beyond belief.
Maybe it's extremely, extremely spicy.
Maybe it's extremely, extremely hard.
Hmm—
Maybe it's sticky and won't break.
Puff—puff—
Maybe it'll leak air and fly away the moment I bite.
Maybe after eating it,
my body will become gigantic.

[P16] But... maybe... this is just an ordinary apple... its color is plain, it doesn't move, and it doesn't make any strange sounds.
Unconsciously, my stomach feels hungry...
*Plink*
Stick it with a finger
Smell it
Touch it
Take a bite
Mom, can I eat this apple?
Sure.

[P17] Crunch!
Mmm, mmm, mmm!
Gulp!
Hmm...
Perhaps, one could say, this is a delicious apple.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《这是苹果吗 也许是吧》，作者为吉竹伸介，译者为毛丹青，由接力出版社出版。画面中央是一个大苹果，周围环绕着与苹果相关的各种想象和科学小图示，一个孩子坐在桌前凝视着苹果。
[P2] 孩子放学回家，发现桌上有一个苹果，他好奇地观察，并开始怀疑这可能不是苹果。
[P3] 孩子继续想象桌上苹果的其他可能性，认为它可能是樱桃的一部分、装着葡萄果冻、一条卷成团的红色鱼，或者削不完的皮，甚至另一面是橘子。
[P4] 孩子继续想象苹果的内部结构，认为它可能是一个复杂的机器；同时，他也想象苹果可能是某种生物的蛋，刚孵出的宝宝可能会把他当作妈妈。
[P5] 孩子想象将苹果种在土里，它会逐渐长成一座巨大的房子，并在三个月后变成一个带有滑梯、秋千和瞭望台的游乐屋，他还可以吃掉果肉来设计自己喜欢的房间。
[P6] 孩子继续想象苹果的多种可能性：它可能想尝试各种发型和帽子，也可能原本想变成梨子、球、邮筒或飞机，但这些想象都因某些细节不符而被否定。
[P7] 孩子想象苹果可能是从宇宙坠落的小行星，仔细观察后发现苹果表面住着许多3毫米高的‘苹果星人’。
[P8] 孩子继续想象苹果可能拥有灵魂，并根据不同情绪和情境，苹果会表现出各种变化，如变白、变软、打呼噜、变扁、变亮、变皱、变硬、打转或疼痛。
[P9] 孩子继续想象苹果的意识和情感，认为它可能知道一切、喜欢自己，并想象苹果可能有各种形状的兄弟姐妹。
[P10] 本页展示了孩子想象中苹果可能拥有的各种兄弟姐妹，它们以不同形状和名称呈现，如大便果、钻石果、星星果等，体现了孩子天马行空的想象力。
[P11] 孩子继续想象苹果的来历，提出了多种可能性：可能是妈妈从超市买回的、喝醉的爸爸拿回来的、爷爷的爷爷的爷爷变的，或是为了抓住他设下的陷阱，甚至可能暗示着某种神秘的讯息。
[P12] 本页通过多个小画面展示了一个苹果在来到孩子家之前可能经历过的各种场景，包括宇宙、火山、恐龙时代、古代文明、海洋、家庭生活等，体现了孩子对苹果过往经历的丰富想象。
[P13] 孩子想象苹果的未来，它可能会召唤伙伴，一起返回家乡，画面中苹果们沿着小路向远方的山峰走去。
[P14] 本页描绘了孩子想象中的世界，所有人都是苹果，而自己是唯一的例外；同时，孩子幻想一个苹果可以长出手脚、变成自己，并通过揉成球、染成红色来完全替代自己，体现了其对身份认同和替代的奇妙想象。
[P15] 孩子想象吃下苹果的各种可能后果，包括无味、极酸、极辣、极硬、黏牙、漏气飞走，或吃后身体变得巨大无比，展现了其丰富的想象力和对未知的探索欲。
[P16] 孩子面对桌上的苹果，先是怀疑它是否普通，随后肚子饿了，便开始用各种方式试探苹果，并最终向妈妈询问是否可以吃，妈妈同意了。
[P17] 孩子尝试吃苹果，发出咀嚼和吞咽的声音，最后得出结论：这可能是一个好吃的苹果。
